acts.title: A Peaceful Season
acts.summary: You arrive with nothing and learn how this world keeps going.
acts.completion: Act One closes quietly. What comes next has not been written.

beats.title: Arrival
beats.text: You leave the cell behind and reach a city that is still whole: warm windows, guarded gates, and people arguing about bread.
beats.hint: Reach one of the five cities.

beats.title: A Trade Learned
beats.text: You learn a recipe and make something with your own hands. The world grows a little less borrowed.

beats.title: A Place to Belong
beats.text: A guild accepts your name. Whatever comes later, you will not face the road entirely alone.

beats.title: A City's Trust
beats.text: Someone in a city trusts your judgment enough to ask for it. You answer carefully.

beats.title: Work Completed
beats.text: A job is finished and paid for. The quiet work of keeping a city standing is larger than any single triumph.

beats.title: Something at the Edge
beats.text: From the last gate, you look back across five cities. The roads are quiet. A bell stops mid-stroke, and no one else seems to notice. You cannot say why the silence stays with you.
